# Current Flavors

### Our current in-store offerings below include seasonal flavors as well as signature flavors, which are always available year-round.

Visit our online [**pint shop**](https://shop.wanderlustcreamery.com/collections/wanderlust-shop) for exclusive flavors not available in stores. Now shipping pints nationwide!

## [Signature Flavors](https://wanderlustcreamery.com/menu#signature) [Seasonal Flavors](https://wanderlustcreamery.com/menu#seasonal)

_All flavors contain dairy unless otherwise specified with_ ⓥ 

_Allergy notice: please be advised that any of our products may contain dairy, tree nuts, peanuts, eggs, wheat and/or gluten. all of our products are prepared on shared equipment where cross contamination may occur._

# Signature Flavors

- ### Malted Ube ( fka Ube Malted Crunch®)

 Inspired by: an American-Filipino upbringing

 Malted milk and sweet purple yam.

 "When we first opened, people asked for an ube ice cream, but ube just isn't novel or inspirational to me. If I were to do an ube cream, it'd be my own rendition. I didn't want to replicate an authentic ube ice cream. Instead, I wanted to capture ube in a way that also reflected my American upbringing." -Chef, Adrienne Borlongan

 It took months, but in July of 2016, we introduced ube malted crunch™. Made with malted milk, sweet purple yams, & crunchy malted milk pieces, this ice cream starts with an old-fashioned American malt flavor but ends with an undeniable ube taste.

 _(Contains: dairy, wheat/gluten)_

 _\*Temporarily served without our signature crunch—the original inclusion was discontinued by its manufacturer, and we’re working on a worth replacement._

- ### Sticky Rice + Mango Ⓥ

 Origin: Thailand

 We were the very first company to innovate this ice cream in 2015 with housemade rice milk, coconut cream, & swirls of alphonso mango. The result captures the exact taste of eating the Thai dessert, and happens to be vegan/ dairy-free!

 _(Contains: coconut, soy traces \*does not contain soy milk)_

- ### Japanese Neapolitan®

 Our signature trio of matcha, sakura (Japanese cherry blossom), and Hokkaido milk ice creams. Contains: dairy, egg

- ### Beurre Noisette Cookie Dough

 Brown Butter Ice Cream Studded with Cookie Dough Bits throughout.

 _Contains: Dairy, Egg, Wheat, Coconut Traces_

- ### Kinder

 Origin: Europe

 Roasted hazelnut ice cream with freckles of gianduja, crunchymilk chocolate pearls, & hazelnut praline.

 _(Contains: dairy, egg, tree nuts, wheat/gluten)_

- ### Wanderlust Vanilla

 Inspired by: All over the globe

 Grass fed custard ice cream studded with vanilla beans from all over the world (Mexico, Madagascar, Uganda, and Indonesia). Each kind of vanilla gives a different dimension of flavor; notes of smoke, cream, musk, and tropical flower come together for a symphony of ultimate vanilla.

 (_Contains: dairy, egg._)

# \- Ube Malted Crunch®

# \- Passionfruit Cacao

- ### Vietnamese Rocky Road™

 Inspired by: HảI vân pass, Vietnam

 HảI vân pass, which translates to “sea cloud pass”, is a thrilling, winding road from đà nang to huế through a landscape of green mountains and sea mist with roadside coffee stops dotted along the way. It inspired this “rocky road” of Vietnamese coffee ice cream laced with “clouds” of condensed milk marshmallow and crunchy caramelized cacao nibs + french roast bits.

 _(Contains: dairy, egg)_

- ### Black Sesame Cookies & Cream

 Inspired by: AAPI Heritage

 White chocolate & black sesame ice cream studded with crispy cookies-n-cream clusters. (Contains: Dairy, Wheat/Gluten, Coconut traces)

- ### Pandan Tres Leches™

 Inspired by: Southeast Asia

 Sweet cream ice cream serves as a blank canvas for crumbs of housemade pandan sponge cake + ribbons of condensed milk in this southeast Asian-inspired take on tres leches.

 _(Contains: dairy, egg, wheat/gluten, soy traces)_

- ### Passionfruit Cacao Ⓥ

 Inspired by: Brazil

 A dairy-free ice cream of passionfruit, coconut, cocoa butter, & raw cacao. Vegan & dairy-free!

 _(Contains: coconut)_

- ### Smoky Road

 Inspired by: The Pacific Northwest

 80% grand cru dark chocolate ice cream. Swirls of housemade vanilla bean marshmallow. Roasted almonds and alder wood smoked sea salt.

 _(Contains: dairy, egg, tree nuts, gelatin)_

### [Seasonal Flavors →](https://wanderlustcreamery.com/menu#seasonal)

# October Seasonal Flavors

- ### Brown Butter Sans Rival

 A yearly fan favorite for over a decade, we spin brown butter ice cream with pieces of housemade crispy cashew dacquoise.

 Contains: dairy, nuts, wheat, egg, coconut traces.

- ### Iskrambol to the MAX

 Real banana-infused pink ice cream with a hint of nostalgic banana-candy flavor, ribboned with Milo chocolate fudge, malted milk crisp, and cereal marshmallows.

 Contains: dairy, egg, wheat, coconut traces

 Contains: Coconut, soy traces

- ### Guava Sampaguita

 Grass fed cream with guava puree, and a whisper of sambac Jasmine tea.

 Contains: dairy

- ### Sapin Sapin

 A Neapolitan of our signature malted ube, sticky rice, and jackfruit ice creams, studded with crispy golden coconut curds.

 Contains: dairy, egg, wheat

- ### TahoⓋ

 A delicate snowy sherbet of silken tofu and soy milk, swirled with roasted tea-infused dark brown sugar syrup and mini chewy pearls. Vegan and dairy free.

 Contains: soy, coconut traces

- ### Thai Tea After Dark

 A haunting swirl of Thai tea ice cream and smoky lapsang souchong-infused dark chocolate ice cream.

 Contains: dairy, egg
